productFit.metricSpecs: German seller: ball head kit 25 kg max. load (leveling head kit 20 kg)

productFit.reason: Listed as #182796 in Leupold's 2024 International Catalog (hosted by the Czech distributor ProArms), but no German, Spanish or Dutch retailer listing was found; US retailers only in search results.

productFit.name: Fatboy Traverse 3 Section Tripod
productFit.metricSpecs: 42,5 mm leg tubes (42,8 / 38,75 / 35,44 mm sections), 47,5 mm rubber feet, 49 mm leg locks (maker gives only these in mm)
productFit.reason: FatBoy sells direct and through US dealers; no EU dealer listed.

productFit.name: BOG DeathGrip Infinite Carbon Fiber Tripod
productFit.metricSpecs: all4shooters measured (not maker): 2925 g, 78 cm packed, clamp about 150 cm high at 20 deg; counterweight hook max. 11,4 kg (25 lb); tubes about 35,4/31,8/28,2 mm
productFit.reason: Sold in the EU by STROBL.CZ (German-language shop), tested by all4shooters.

productFit.name: Primos Trigger Stick Gen3 Tall Tripod
productFit.reason: Sold in Spain as "trípode de caza Primos Trigger Stick Gen3 alto" (Hunternature, Fawna).

localFacts.fact: Iberia allows a cabin bag of max. 56 x 40 x 25 cm and 10 kg; folded, the Vortex (71 cm), Leupold (74 cm), Fatboy (67 cm) and BOG (78 cm) are all longer and go in the hold.
In Spain the Primos Trigger Stick Gen3 is sold as a "trípode de caza", adjustable from 61 cm to 157 cm (24 to 62 in).
all4shooters measured the BOG DeathGrip Infinite CF at 2925 g and 78 cm packed, clamp about 150 cm high at full extension; sold in the EU by STROBL.CZ.
A German seller lists the Vortex Radian Carbon ball head kit at 25 kg max. load (leveling head kit 20 kg).
Local terms: trípode de tiro / trípode de caza, rótula, cabezal nivelador, carril Arca-Swiss, carril Picatinny, posición (tendido, sentado, rodilla, de pie).

localPainPoints.pain: On a cheap tripod the rifle and scope tend to move under their own weight unless perfectly balanced.
localPainPoints.fix: A ball head with an Arca clamp that locks the rail, rated well above the rifle weight (English post fix for saddle wiggle).

quotes.text: le veo poca estabilidad y por el peso del rifle y el visor tiende a moverse si no está perfectamente equilibrado

localPainPoints.pain: Every gram counts when the tripod is carried a lot.
localPainPoints.fix: Fatboy legs 2,7 kg or BOG 2,9 kg if you walk, the 1,6 kg Primos for stalks; the 3,3 kg kits near the car or at the range.

quotes.text: cualquier gramo que te quites de pes, parece que no pero es fundamental

localPainPoints.pain: Hunters set up the tripod and still shoot off-hand out of habit.
localPainPoints.fix: Practise the positions off the tripod before the season, the same lean each time (English post setup step 6).

quotes.text: me pasa una pieza y la sigo tirando a pulso, ni me acuerdo del trípode

localGain.point: Folded lengths checked against the Iberia cabin bag size (56 cm): none of the four carbon kits fits.
